'''Hero of Tython's lightsaber''' was a [[Color/Legends|blue]]-bladed [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] created and wielded by the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] known as the [[Hero of Tython]].

==Behind the scenes==
Depending on the player's advanced class, the lightsaber could be a single-bladed or [[Lightsaber/Legends|dual-bladed lightsabers]].
